claims.quote: The Odessa barb, Pethia padamya, is a small cyprinid from central Myanmar, also recorded from the lower Chindwin, a tributary of the Ayeyarwady.
In 2001 the first wild-collected specimens could be traced, which showed that this fish is a wild species originating from Burma (Myanmar).
